area_multiplied_by_10.note: A tenfold typing error (for example a thousands separator).

area_multiplied_by_2.note: Fixed plausibility bounds catch large typing errors only; moderate errors are expected to pass.

area_multiplied_by_3.note: Fixed plausibility bounds catch large typing errors only; moderate errors are expected to pass.

consistent_synthetic_text_false_flags.note: Text built from the same fields; every flag here would be a false positive.

coordinates_removed.note: Missing data must give 'unknown', never an invented fact or a flag.
